text: Commercial Per Plant Intelligence service Delivered to commercial specification and in service on UK farms. Commercially available for farmers and corporates Corporates include seed companies and nutrient companies. A greener future for our planet and a more profitable future for farmers. Per Plant Farming Tom Dick Significant advances with multi probe design Onboard computer vision developed Harry Developed to Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 4 Wilma Advanced software platform and a management interface Billions of data points Per plant crop and weed count Weed density threshold algorithm for treatment threshold We are reducing our time to market through developing a modular robotic component architecture. Creation of a distributed, AI driven operating system called Faas-OS. This software will autonomously control farming robots across multiple broadacre farms, based purely on inputs gathered and analysed with minimal human interaction. Creation of an Electrical Weed Killing system to reduce the use of chemicals. Electricity is a scalable and sustainable alternative to herbicides and addresses the fundamental shortcomings of herbicides. This project will create prototype weeding solutions for new crop types Developing a Soil Assessment tool that agronomists and farmers can use to improve soil health using a low-cost method that will measure Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs) or “soil gases”, produced by soil microorganisms to determine soil health. Creation of a system to detect slugs and treat them, without the use of chemicals
